name: stellar-suspects
description: Stellar Suspects — browser multiplayer social deduction game (monorepo)

scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @stellar/shared && npm run dev -w @stellar/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w @stellar/shared && npm run dev -w @stellar/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stellar/shared && npm run build -w @stellar/server && npm run build -w @stellar/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @stellar/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
